dct_description_sm: There is an increasing interest in the presence of contaminants in the environment and how these are taken up in food webs. This issue is particularly important to land-based communities who rely directly on the land for access to culturally and nutritionally important country foods (e.g., through hunting, fishing, harvesting/gathering, etc.). This dataset shares data and metadata from a review of publications focused on contaminants in one group of important country foods – wild berries – in Canada. The dataset is intended to support researchers and community practitioners with understanding the state of the research on this topic and can be used to orient future studies focused on wild berry contamination.
dct_title_s: Database: Studies on contaminants in wild berries in Canada
